get_remote_fs_cache: get the global RemoteFsCache singleton instance for caching remote filesystem listings and file stats
get_or_create_fs_entry: get or create a cache entry for a remote URI by scanning the remote filesystem once
get_cached_filesystem: get a WholeFileCacheFileSystem wrapper for a remote URI to cache file content locally
get_file_stats: get cached file stats including size and mode for a relative path in the remote filesystem
get_cache_stats: get statistics about the cache contents including file count and cached stats count per URI
